option.name: SCRIPT_TEXT
option.value: cd samples/iosApp && xcodegen generate --quiet && UDID=$(xcrun simctl list devices available | grep -F ' iPhone 17 Pro (' | tail -1 | sed -E 's/.*\(([0-9A-F-]{36})\).*/\1/') && xcrun simctl bootstatus $UDID -b && open -a Simulator && xcodebuild -project GalleryApp.xcodeproj -scheme GalleryApp -sdk iphonesimulator -destination id=$UDID -derivedDataPath build build -quiet && xcrun simctl install $UDID build/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/GalleryApp.app && xcrun simctl launch --terminate-running-process $UDID com.jantursky.stipple.samples.gallery
